fusions.name: Snarl of Strands
fusions.desc: Lashes strands around every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage, stripping 10% armour for 6 seconds, slowing each by 25% and stunning each for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Raking Comb
fusions.desc: A raking strike that deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Whisker Sense
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Mantle
fusions.desc: Conjures a mantle of fine strands: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by a further 4%.
